Medieval-style houses of large clean stone bricks sit behind the trees, melting into leaves and plants. On a sidewalk branching off to the left, a young boy leaps up and grabs a small ball-shaped toy drone with feather-like rotors out of the air, while two smaller children ride tricycles nearby and their parents watch. Soft green light filtering through the leaves.
